findings.message:
Both award faces are character-for-character the statements of record. 'theorem forest_extension_inequality {X : Type u} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (G : SimpleGraph X)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsAcyclic) (k : ℕ) :
    (Fintype.card X : ℤ) * Erdos993G1.indepCount G k
      ≤ (k + 1) * Erdos993G1.indepCount G (k + 1) + 3 * k * Erdos993G1.indepCount G k' occurs verbatim in LeanProject/LeanProof/Main.lean (entry 55), in SOLUTION-CONTRACT.md §2, in cycles/cycle-1/stage6/SYNTHESIS.md '## Lean awards' (C1-LA1), in control/C1-STAGE7-FORMALIZER-BRIEF-LA1.md §2, and as THEOREM-CONTRACT.yaml lean_binding.expected_statement (recomputed sha256 47809abc5c4e94d89aa1859886dbd44cc040d742d3ed0b214aae7adcc240fe18, equal to the declared value). The (DL) face is byte-identical to the same four records apart from the leading keyword 'lemma' in place of 'theorem'.

Every carried U3 declaration (mem_extensionFinset_iff, isNIndepSet_insert_of_mem_extensionFinset, isNIndepSet_erase_and_mem_extensionFinset, sigma_card_double_count, sum_card_indepSetFinset_succ, sum_e_eq_succ_mul_card, double_count, card_closedNbhdFinset_le, e_add_card_add_degreeSum_ge, e_ge_sub) differs from sources/c1-stage7-sources/U3-Extension.lean only by the registrar keyword 'theorem' -> 'lemma', forced by the one-terminal-theorem rule; statement text and proof script are otherwise byte-identical. The producer records this keyword delta as a re-derivation. U2's row-8 file is not carried, so the three Gate-ruling-3 renames do not arise; no fenced external identifier (icoeff, Zgen, indepPoly, vpoly, Dpoly, Epoly, degDefect, indepCard, numExtensions, sum_degOn_le, prefix_ratio, degOn, indepFinsets, mem_indepFinsets) occurs anywhere in the source.

Disclosed deviation, reviewed and accepted as harmless to both award faces: the run defines no Erdos993G1.firstDescent, and the contract lists none, although formalizer brief R3 names firstDescent alongside indepDegreeSum and extensionCount/e. firstDescent (x) is a dependency of (XR)/C1-LA4, not of forest_degree_lemma or forest_extension_inequality; its body depends on an existence lemma and so cannot be registered under the registrar's definition-before-lemma ordering. Including it would have added an object neither award face uses. The producer states the deviation in FORMALIZER-REPORT.md \u00a78 and \u00a7Remaining gates. indepDegreeSum and e are both present with their Lean text. Flagged for controller adjudication only; it is not a statement-fidelity defect.

Defect in a control file, not in the artifact: control/C1-STAGE7-FORMALIZER-BRIEF-LA1.md has no '## 3' section header. Its mandatory repairs are numbered R1-R9 inside '## 2. Award statement', and the cross-references in \u00a75 ('R7' for the contract, 'R8' for axioms, 'R9' for the informal proof, 'R10' for salvage) are each offset by four from those numbers. The reviewer brief's phrase 'the controller's formalizer brief \u00a72 lists the fences and \u00a73 the mandatory repairs' therefore has no \u00a73 to point at. I read the R1-R9 block as the mandatory repairs and checked each. No effect on the award.

forest_degree_lemma is registered with kind 'lemma' while SOLUTION-CONTRACT \u00a72 and the synthesis print it with the keyword 'theorem'. This is not a weakening: the formalizer brief \u00a72 directs 'Register forest_degree_lemma as lemma kind and forest_extension_inequality as the one terminal theorem', and in Lean 4 'lemma' and 'theorem' produce the same declaration. Statement text is otherwise byte-identical.

The G1 definitions of record Erdos993G1.indepCount, coeff and delta (run entries 1-3) and the lemma indepCount_eq_card_indepSetFinset (run entry 17) are byte-identical to entries 1-4 of sources/r25/c4-forest-descent-order-bound/LeanProject/LeanProof/Main.lean (sha256 736eb9dfb6ba82b0e099fe70df9e4d7f780bccdbd24ca240f4ad1115cfe7dfe0), with the r25 entry digests reproduced exactly. indepDegreeSum, closedNbhdFinset, extensionFinset and e are byte-identical to sources/c1-stage7-sources/U3-Extension.lean and match SEMANTIC-CONTRACT.md \u00a71 (D_k as the sum over G.indepSetFinset k of the incident degrees; e(J) as the card of univ minus the closed neighbourhood). All 16 contract definitions' recorded Lean text occurs verbatim in the registered source, and all 55 registrar entry digests reproduce sha256 of their bodies.

Every fence of SOLUTION-CONTRACT \u00a73 and formalizer brief \u00a72 is honoured by the contract's scope text and by the artifact. \u00a73.3: the contract conclusion and forest_degree_lemma's docstring both state the average character and disclaim any pointwise bound. \u00a73.1: no key of r25 Tier 1, E993-G1WIDE-NO-SIZE-CAP, NR1, FOREST, TREE, TRANSFER, the aggregates or Erd\u0151s #993 is mentioned or relied on; INFORMAL-PROOF.md \u00a711.6 states this. \u00a73.2: nothing asymptotic. \u00a73.6: one source importing only Mathlib, namespace Erdos993G1 only, every declaration authored in-run or carried from an in-run source with its digest. Attribution (FLNYZ 2026 \u00a78 for the mathematics; C-F1-T for the injection derivation; U3/C-U1-T for the compiled (EX) step) travels on both award docstrings and in the contract. No fenced object occurs in the artifact. coeff and delta are registered as definitions only; no order-bound, descent or Delta_k statement is proved or implied.

Hypotheses of the terminal theorem are exactly [Fintype X], [DecidableEq X], [DecidableRel G.Adj], (hG : G.IsAcyclic) and the universally quantified (k : \u2115). Acyclicity and finiteness only; no alpha/indepNum side condition, no (\u2605)/hyp-alpha, no order or rank restriction, no extra conjunct, no dropped conjunct. Binders are instance binders on a general 'Type u' carrier, never one fixed Fintype instance, so C-U3-F's load-bearing composition caveat is honoured. Acyclicity is consumed exactly once mathematically, at Erdos993G1.rootPath_unique (via SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic.path_unique) and propagated; the counting core Erdos993G1.double_count and Erdos993G1.e_ge_sub carry no hG binder, as the synthesis requires.

RECEIPTS/kernel-verification.json (sha256 c721cf79589183904e856a079840408f1a38bb4a31f94cd2db34a98abc6749bb) carries verdict.code 'verified' with verdict.verified true; all eleven checks pass; source_sha256_before and source_sha256_after are both b49ea82a33edc55f8185379c3abd44e13a17914b7f8b9ab0bf5e2aaac5aafc5a, equal to the hash I recomputed over the file the brief names and to lean_binding.declaration_source_sha256. THEOREM-CONTRACT.yaml recomputes to 58e4d0a8e5b473c06b5ca2d8693ad3f58bf5fa964cb2451a251837273b306997 and EVIDENCE/fidelity-audit-input.json as received to 57497769cbbcb1a99beb3df58b1ad62d15ed0f48212bac6202fdf969ee8f39a0, both equal to the values the brief declares. Toolchain pinned to Lean 4.32.2 and Mathlib 905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c; shared packages bound read-only.

Conditions R1-R9 of the formalizer brief are each present in the artifact and independently confirmed: R1 (single source, G1 entries byte-identical, digests reproduced), R2 (carry discipline as above), R3 (contract with every definition by exact lean_name and its registered Lean text, hypotheses verbatim, closed dependency graph, the three permitted axioms, expected_statement the exact namespace-relative terminal source text, 22 source materials matched), R4 (EVIDENCE/axioms.txt names exactly propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; all 55 lines of axioms-all-declarations.txt are subsets of those three; no sorry, admit, native_decide or axiom token in the source), R5 (INFORMAL-PROOF.md at statement granularity with the hypothesis-entry and cast audits), R6 (not invoked; nothing blocked), R7 (the injection route of record was followed and the switch point never reached), R8 ((EX) from (DL) by the carried U3 theorems), R9 (both terminal statements in the integers, no natural-number subtraction).

Non-vacuous. Witness satisfying every hypothesis: X := Fin 2 (Fintype, DecidableEq), G := the single-edge graph on Fin 2 (DecidableRel G.Adj; acyclic, since a cycle needs length at least three). At k = 1: n = 2, i_1 = 2, i_2 = 0, D_1 = 2, so (DL) reads 2 <= 4 and (EX) reads 4 <= 0 + 6. At k = 0 the same witness gives i_0 = 1, i_1 = 2 and (EX) reads 2 <= 2, an equality, so the conclusion is not satisfied by slack alone. The hypothesis class is populated for every order and every k.

Checked before attesting, as the brief requires. The input's contract projection reproduces THEOREM-CONTRACT.yaml field for field (16 definitions, 3 domains, 3 quantifiers, 3 hypotheses, the conclusion, the three permitted axioms) with no paraphrase and no omission; theorem_contract.contract_sha256 equals the hash of the contract file. The binding projection's lean_statement is exact source text that occurs verbatim in Main.lean, and its declaration_source_sha256 equals the hash of that file. The recomputed fingerprints (contract 47a579242971a9e76c835ac1ee0776bd380493c7398f4072eef7c1cf40914798, binding 1543f0e8d1416115c87ee0983a7fc65f1c11fe6c1d29806681fe274be7024eb5) equal the controller's declared values. Reviewer id c1-la1-fable-fidelity-20260925 differs from producer id c1-la1-formalizer-opus-20260925, as RECEIPTS/reviewer-assignment.json records.
